notes.title: Release Date - May 27th!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there![/h3]

We wanted to make a short post, to let people know that our next big update will release on May 27th. This will mark the game's transition from early access to full release.

We'll share a much more detailed news post to share on the release day, thank you to everyone who has played our game and we hope you'll give the new version a try once it's out!


[b]What's included in the update?[/b]
[list]
[*]A brand-new map, set during World War 2 in Europe
Our plan was always to have the player visit different periods of time, we've been to the future and now it's time to go to the past.
[*]New WW2 weapons (M1 Garand, PPSh-41, M1911, and more!)
We've added a bunch of new weapons from the WW2 era. You'll be able to try them all on the new map.
[*]The "Final Boss"
Survive long enough on the new map, and you'll have to face the final boss. (You may find a hint as to who it is in the cover image for this post!)


[*]Shooting Range!
As requested, we've added a shooting range. You can visit the shooting range from the computer in the spaceship, give all the avaliable weapons a try on some dummy enemies.
[*]Easter eggs!
Every map now has secret easter egg objectives and rewards, can you figure them all out?
[*]Level and drop system revamp
Players will now earn timed case drops simply for playing the game, instead of levelling up. Players can earn up to 3 case drops every day, one gets granted for every 30 minutes of game time.
Achievements for leveling up will now stop at level 10, so it'll be easier for people to obtain all the achievements without grinding to level 20.
[/list]

notes.title: Locked & Loaded!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey There![/h2]
We just wanted to write a small announcement post to let people know that we're still working on finishing the game. We are working on the "1.0" update so we can move the game from Early Access to a full release.

[b]The main content of the 1.0 update will be a brand new map set during WW2, with classic weapons to boot, and yet another makeover for the zombies![/b]

For now, please enjoy this teaser of these special dual-wield pistols which you'll be able to obtain on your World War 2 expedition:

notes.title: Big Update Time!
notes.content:
[h1]We've launched the game, now the first major update is ready![/h1]

Firstly, a huge thank you to anyone who has bought and supported our little indie game, we appreciate it so much. 

We've cooked up a big update for you all, it's an early access game after all, so please look forward to more updates in the future!

[h2]Notable changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]New music!
[*]New hard difficulty option for each map!
[*]New weapon, the APS submachine gun!
[*]Level cap increased from 10 to 20!
[*]New achievements!
[/list]

[h2]Finally, some music![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40745347/be42098c17cf1d45ebb39ec704a288efe5d6d17b.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Music has been added to each map, listen to some bangers as you lay waste to the army of zombies!
[*]Each map has an interactable boombox in the starting area, so you can enable and disable the music as you please easily during gameplay
[*]The songs will get more intense during later waves to help ramp up the tension, we hope you enjoy!
[/list]

[h2]New Weapon! - APS Submachine Gun[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40745347/27ff428c0def89c044755e080161bdca47a50d37.jpg[/img]
The APS is a brand new submachine gun we've added to the game today. 
[list]
[*]Easy to control and high damage compared to other SMGs.
[*]It's quite rare, try your luck and get it from the vending machine or mystery box on any map.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40745347/905bb0d109ec2698df894f754a8b4a27edf44476.jpg[/img]


[h2]New difficulty option, test your skills on the Hard difficulty![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40745347/d395dad25633bf634407a5a4dd645a049635c6f7.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]A new Hard mode difficulty option has been added to each map
[*]You can select it from the map select screen on the spaceship
[*]Separate leaderboards for hard difficulty on each map
[*]Zombies will rush you down relentlessly, and you'll take damage faster, have you got what it takes?
[/list]


[h2]Various bug fixes, balance tweaks, and other changes![/h2]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a lighting issue on Trailer Park which made the shadows/dark areas appear to be striped
[*]Fixed a bug with the hit sound effect being played too many times while shooting zombies with shotguns
[*]Tweaked the footstep sounds to prevent audio overlapping/glitching when there are many zombies active at the same time
[*]Fixed a UI overlap bug on the skin select screen in the loadout menu
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Starting cash increased from 0 to 500
[*]Level cap increased from 10 to 20
[*]Added new Steam Achievements
[*]Replaced the music on the main menu
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced damage for the Eradicator, and it's upgraded variant
[*]Viper SMG damage reduced, increased the damage of the upgraded variant
[*]Viper SMG spread/recoil reduced
[*]PM-334 pistol upgraded variant damage increased
[*]Halved the amount of time required to collect the power source rocks, and the time required to activate the weapon upgrade machine
[/list]
